## Security Standard Operating Procedure
# Part one: Succession, and acting HoS. Succession dictates who is granted the title of Acting Captain in an emergency, or otherwise simply lacking one. Succession is as follows: Head of Sec > Warden > Brigmedic > Duty Officer > Highest seniority Security Officer (Cadets are generally ineligible for acting outside of extreme circumstances, however calling ERT or faxing Central Command for help should be considered before this is required)
# Part two: Armaments and armor, per alert level Green: Security should only have standard issue arms and armor. Blue: Security may be issued additional munitions and armor depending on the confirmed threat, at the discretion of the HoS, or Warden. Red: Security should be issued longarms and armor relevant to the confirmed threat. Crew arming should be at the sole discretion of the Warden AND (acting) HoS, or (acting) Captain, should either be missing. Delta/Gamma: All bets are off. All hands on deck. Usage of contraband is entirely authorized to preserve the lives of all remaining crew. Recovery efforts should be made for all dead or dying personnel. Yellow/Orange: Officers should be issued relevant protective equipment based on the threat. On orange, securing and protecting evac is priority one.
# Part three: Corruption Corruption generally should not happen within the Security department, and should be policed by reports to the Captain, HoS, and if all else fails, CentComm. Roles higher in succession than Brigmedic (including Brigmed themself) *should not* act corrupt, to keep Security fair for all other players. Corruption should be policed in character, and is not necessarily a rulebreak as long as it is not taken too far (or used to allow/facilitate metagrudging/metafriending). When in doubt, use ahelp to see if your actions are okay.
# Part four: Permits, and Contraband Generally, crew are not permitted to carry contraband their role is not authorized to have (aka, job-specific contraband). Minor and Major (non-syndicate) contraband may be assigned permits by the HoS and Warden (or (acting) Captain, if neither are present). Highly illegal contraband is not permitted on station. Salvage teams may keep Highly Illegal Soviet contraband on their shuttle, but outside of present emergencies (Red, Gamma, etc.) should not be on station with it. In the event of Red, and especially Delta or Gamma, all contraband is permitted to ensure the lives of the crew are protected. Remember: You are here to make sure everyone gets home alive, and to ensure the safety of the crew.
# Part five: Deputization Non-security Command members, and the Salvage Team (assuming they are mindshielded) may be deputized in the event of an emergency (confirmed threat on blue or higher, in the event of low sec presence). This allows them to utilize some Security contraband (non-lethals on blue, lethals on red/higher) to assist any existing Security members. They will be subject to relevant SOP just like other Sec.
